cases.testName: agent completion claim cannot prove an unverified goal
cases.expected: Completion is refused and the goal remains active without trusted evidence.

cases.testName: one passing check cannot bypass another semantic acceptance requirement
cases.expected: A passing mechanical check cannot complete a goal with an unproven semantic requirement.

cases.testName: progress notes do not count as host-observed progress
cases.expected: Three narration-only continuation turns pause the goal with stalledTurns=3.
Repeating a blocker inside one turn does not inflate the counter; the third distinct turn blocks.

cases.testName: active goal owns compaction context and generic auto-continue
cases.expected: Persistent goal state is injected into compaction and generic post-compaction auto-continue is disabled.

cases.testName: restart recovery preserves interrupted-turn accounting and prompt ownership
cases.expected: Recovery waits for bootstrap, restores command ownership, and does not count the interrupted turn as stalled.

cases.testName: cleared unfinished goal restores paused and only resumes after explicit command
cases.expected: Restore preserves the archived Goal but returns it paused; work resumes only after an explicit /goal resume command.

cases.testName: restore cannot overwrite a different unfinished live goal
cases.expected: Restore fails closed while another unfinished Goal is live and does not change that live Goal.

cases.testName: explicit OpenCode usage limit stops automatic goal retry while generic retry remains active
cases.expected: Explicit account quota becomes usage_limited and aborts retry; generic transient retry stays active.

cases.testName: budget-limited goal cannot resume until its budget is raised
cases.expected: An exhausted local budget cannot be bypassed by resume; raising the limit preserves usage and revision.

cases.testName: goal edit aborts the old turn, suppresses abort-idle, and rejects stale revision activity
cases.expected: User edit wins the race; stale revision patches/progress cannot mutate the revised goal.
